fiona: Quick noteI pushed a draft PR that consolidates the batching + cache guidance into one short migration section for Optimize. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5230 
kevin: Thanks. Is this the one that replaces the separate 'batching tips' and 'kv-cache' pages?
marco: If so, please keep the small SDK snippet differences (JS vs Go) visible. People copy-paste and get broken imports.
sam: Can we also add a small decision table recommending when to use prefix prefetch vs kv-cache? Support still sees the same confusion repeatedly.
fiona: Added a tiny decision bullet (prefetch for anticipated cold prefixes; kv-cache for dynamic session state). Kept it 3 bullets so it fits the migration flow.
kevin: Snippets: please ensure the JS example shows `await client.prefetch(...).catch()` pattern to avoid unhandled rejections. Also show `client.close()` in a finally block.
marco: The Go snippet needed update: `OldKVHandler` -> `KVCacheManager` rename; also make sure `Init` vs `Setup` naming is correct.
fiona: Fixed both snippets and pushed. Also added a 1-line migration table: "Old API -> New API" entries.
docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [ ] reviewer assigned, [ ] snippets linted, [ ] links validated, [ ] UX decision table reviewed
link-bot: link-check: found 1 internal anchor mismatch: /docs/optimize/kv -> /docs/optimize/cache/kv
fiona: Thanks link-bot. Updated the anchor and pushed.
ci-bot: md-lint passed, snippets/format-check failed (js)
fiona: Formatting JS snippet with prettier and pushing.
(1m)
ci-bot: snippets/format-check passed, link-check passed
kevin: Quick language request: for quant profile statements avoid absolutes. Use "minimal observed quality delta" and link to the evals page.
fiona: Done. Reworded quant section and added link to /docs/optimize/evals/regression-alerts.
marco: Tiny perf note: include reproduction knobs so readers can replicate the benchmark: - hw: A100 - batch: 8 - seq: 1024 - quant: qprof-compact-int8
sam: Also add a fallback reminder: prefetch/kvcache do not create prefixes; runtime will fall back to pinned model variant. That's a recurring support question.
fiona: Added the fallback reminder and a crosslink to /docs/optimize/fallbacks.
kevin: Want to review for technical accuracy. Assigning myself.
kevin: Quick review doneLGTM on technical content. One suggestion: move the decision bullets into a collapsible callout to keep the page scannable.
fiona: Moved into a collapsible note and pushed.
docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [x] reviewer assigned (kevin), [x] snippets linted, [x] links validated, [x] UX decision table reviewed
fiona: Merged and deployed to staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize/batch-cache-compact-migration
marco: Smoke looks fine in staging. Code blocks highlight, callouts render.
sam: Verified the crosslinks and fallback note. lgtm.
kevin: Thanks everyone. This should cut down a few repeated support threads. :+1:
